description: This file defines the WindowContainer class and related functions for parsing and constructing window hierarchy objects from protocol buffer data, including methods for creating configurations and handling various window-related components.

classes.name: WindowContainer
classes.description: Represents a window container object with methods to construct instances from protocol buffer data.

methods.name: fromProto
methods.description: Creates a WindowContainer instance from protocol buffer data, including its children.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds additional attributes to a WindowContainer instance based on proto data.

methods.name: childrenFromProto
methods.description: Creates child window components from proto data.

methods.name: createConfigurationContainer
methods.description: Creates a ConfigurationContainer object from proto data.

methods.name: createConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a Configuration object from proto data.

methods.name: createWindowConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a WindowConfiguration object from proto data.
